newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan students clash with police.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan students clash with police.

text.p: University students hurling firebombs and rocks clashed with police on Tuesday in central Caracas during a protest against the government's austerity economic policies.

The incident took place at the end of a peaceful demonstration by about 1,000 people as marchers neared Congress, witnesses said. One national guard and a female television journalist were slightly hurt. There were no immediate reports of arrests.

Led by the rector of Venezuela's largest university, the protesters shouted slogans denouncing an International Monetary Fund-inspired economic package which they blamed for "starvation" among poorer Venezuelans.
The brief disturbances forced the postponement of a congressional debate on a key privatisation bill because of a lack of quorum.
